api.base_url: https://{instance}/entity/{endpointName}/{version}/ e.g. /entity/Default/24.200.001 (path convention from general knowledge, UNVERIFIED on fetched page); token at https://{instance}/identity/connect/token

scopes_needed_read: offline_access (api scope grants contract-based REST and SOAP per Acumatica doc)
auth.refresh: Authorization code, implicit, and resource owner password flows supported per Acumatica docs; offline_access refresh token; Nango config also uses password grant under OAUTH2_CC

access_requirements.partner_program_name: Acumatica ISV / Technology partner program for certified listing and dev licenses (UNVERIFIED)
access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: ISV certification only for Acumatica Marketplace; not needed for private connection
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Open Connected Applications (SM303010), add an OAuth 2.0 application (flow, redirect URI, scopes), generate shared secret; client ID format <GUID>@<CompanyID>; create/assign an API user with a role; confirm license allows web services API users.
access_requirements.time_to_approval: Same day after customer admin step

sandbox.how_to_get: Acumatica trial/dev instance via partner portal or customer test tenant (public self-serve UNVERIFIED)

rate_limits: License-based: Web API requests per minute Essentials 50, Select 100, Prime 150, Enterprise 300; also max concurrent requests and max API users; requests delayed at 50% of limit (help.acumatica.com License Restrictions for API Users, via search snippet)

events: Push Notifications (webhook on entity changes) and Business Events; list UNVERIFIED

incremental_sync: OData $filter=LastModifiedDateTime gt datetimeoffset'...' on contract-based entities; Generic Inquiry via OData as alternative

unified_api_coverage.apideck: yes by name (Acumatica present in connectors page text)

blockers: Low per-minute API limits on small license tiers (50/min) make backfill slow
Customer license caps number of API users and concurrent requests
